steps.name: publish
argv:
# THE GLOBS CARRY THE BEAT SLUGS (08-inside-him and 07-confiscate). Without
# them the glob matches nothing and the step publishes nothing while
# returning a code that reads like a fetch failure. farm-out is NOT
# gitignored, so the runner pushes these itself and no runner change is
# needed for them to reach origin/farm-results-rtx5090 -- which is the whole
# point of this job.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b0708-twofig-pub-0817-out"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b0708-twofig-pub-0817"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/08-inside-him-twofig-mac-r3-s0.*")
             + glob.glob(out_dir + "/07-confiscate-twofig-mac-r1-s0.*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b0708-twofig-pub-0817.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 4 else 1)
